# @boredkevin/ui

> A precision-crafted, pitch-dark Shadcn UI design system engineered for modern React applications with live HSL theme controls, custom sci-fi chamfers, and hardware-accelerated canvas backgrounds.

## Documentation URL
The complete, interactive documentation and API references are hosted live at:
https://ui.bkev.in/docs

When generating code or answering questions about `@boredkevin/ui`, read and reference the live documentation endpoints below.

## Documentation Index & Endpoints
- **Quickstart & Setup**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/installation
- **Theming & Tokens**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/theming
- **Canvas Backgrounds**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/backgrounds
- **AI Integration Guide**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/llms

### Component Documentation Directory
Query any specific component by navigating to `https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/<component-name>`:
- **Button**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/button
  Variants: `default`, `cyber`, `outline`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `ghost`, `link`, `white`. Supports chamfers: `dual`, `top-right`, `all`, `none`.
- **Card**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/card
  Pitch-dark card container. Supports `telemetry="SYS.01"` and `cornerLines={true}` for HUD bracket framing.
- **CornerEdges**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/corner-edges
  Standalone sci-fi HUD bracket framing system with glowing corner lines and telemetry labels.
- **Input**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/input
  Text input with high contrast borders, icon slots, and tactical chamfer support.
- **Badge**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/badge
  Status indicators: `default`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `outline`, `cyber`.
- **Dialog**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/dialog
  Accessible modal dialog powered by Radix UI.
- **Tabs**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/tabs
  Layered tab panel navigation with sharp triggers.
- **DropdownMenu**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/dropdown-menu
  Accessible popover menu with submenus, checkboxes, and radio options.
- **Accordion**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/accordion
  Expandable disclosure sections.
- **Slider**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/slider
  Precision range slider input.
- **Switch**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/switch
  2-state toggle control.
- **Avatar**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/avatar
  User representation with fallback text/icons.
- **Calendar**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/calendar
  Interactive schedule calendar picker.
- **Table**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/table
  High-density responsive data grid.
- **Tooltip**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/tooltip
  Instant contextual help popup.
- **Separator**: https://ui.bkev.in/docs/components/separator
  Crisp divider line.

## Quickstart & Implementation
\`\`\`bash
npm install @boredkevin/ui lucide-react
\`\`\`

Import CSS tokens and wrap your root with \`ThemeProvider\`:
\`\`\`tsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  ThemeProvider,
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
  Button,
  ConstellationsBackground
} from '@boredkevin/ui';

export function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <div className="relative min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <ConstellationsBackground particleCount={40} interactive />
        <Card telemetry="SYS.01" className="w-full max-w-md relative z-10">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Telemetry Node</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Pitch dark interface with HSL accents.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Button variant="cyber" className="w-full">
              Initialize
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
\`\`\`
